author: Ahimanikya Satapathy

sources.title: Subhas Chandra Bose · An Indian Pilgrim
sources.note: Chapters I, IV and V, especially pages 6, 29–32, 36–40 and 43–46; reproduced preface dated 23 January 1948.

sources.title: Incredible India · Netaji Birth Place Museum
sources.note: Official collection description: family letters, school certificates and photographs. Individual display labels and current access were not independently checked.

evidence_limits: Re-typeset retrospective autobiography, not a manuscript or critical-edition collation. The reproduced 1948 preface is not the date of composition.
reading_gain: Explains how English brought recognition while Bengali exposed a learning gap, how Das’s influence continued in correspondence and contemplation, and how memoir and museum evidence answer different questions.
